optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Finance Operations Analyst, Credit Workflow System

professionalSummary.text: Owns the disbursement reconciliation control and leads the month-end reconciliation close for the credit book.
professionalSummary.witness: Led the month-end disbursement reconciliation close for the credit book at a commercial bank for twenty-two months, as the named control owner in the finance control register, running the close timetable and signing the close-out checklist.

experienceHighlights.text: Approves reconciliation adjustments within a delegated limit and escalates larger ones to the finance controller.
experienceHighlights.witness: Held a delegated approval limit of 25,000 for reconciliation adjustments, approving adjustments within the limit in the reconciliation tool under my own user id and escalating larger ones to the finance controller with a proposed treatment.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Maintains the reconciliation procedure and the control evidence pack.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the control evidence pack each month for internal audit, including the adjustment log, the sign-off record and the break ageing report.

skills.text: Coordinates the close timetable with treasury and the credit operations team and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Agreed the close timetable each month with treasury and the credit operations team, recording in the close plan that treasury owned the funding entries and credit operations owned the disbursement queue.
